propositions: An s3:// or s3+zip:// remote URL without a git-remote-s3 helper >=0.3.2 allows multiple .bundle files per ref, corrupting the store; the system currently detects this corruption only after it occurs rather than preventing it.

A new _require_s3_helper_if_s3_url() guard must be called before any store push operation, detecting S3 mode purely from the remote URL scheme (s3:// or s3+zip://), resolving the URL once and reusing existing git remote get-url calls.

OptionalDependencyError must propagate unconditionally from the S3 preflight, independent of push_tickets_branch's best-effort strict flag, so that it halts write_and_push and is re-raised through push_after_commit rather than swallowed by best-effort exception handling.
The guard must be wired into three call sites: synchronous push at push.py line 418 (after URL resolution), async arm before process detach, and init/mount at _mount_or_create_branch (line 383).
Non-s3:// remotes must treat the preflight as a no-op, and an unresolvable remote must keep its existing best-effort remote-not-found skip without being misidentified as S3 mode.
